name: independent-review-of-phenotype-extraction
title: Independent review of phenotype extraction from 20 rare disease case reports
description: Two reviewers independently recorded patients, phenotypic findings (HPO), observation basis and frequency statements in the abstract and full text of 20 case reports, blind to model output and regional assignment; with the automated pipeline output for the same documents.

contributors.title: Paul N. Schofield
contributors.organization: Department of Physiology, Development and Neuroscience, University of Cambridge, United Kingdom

contributors.title: Marwa Abdelhakim
contributors.organization: King Abdullah University of Science and Technology, Thuwal, Saudi Arabia
